#include <iostream>

bool can(int n, int w) {
    if (n == 0) return true;
    int r = n % w;
    if (r == 0 || r == 1) return can(n / w, w);
    if (r == w - 1) return can(n / w + 1, w);
    return false;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    std::cout << (can(m, w) ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
